question: Should maintainers sponsor this branch as the heartbeat commitment fix, narrow it to prompt hardening only, or let the broader pending-question/proactive-context work own the session-context portion?
rationale: The prompt guard is narrow, but the session-context fix overlaps open architectural work and the current mirror-only approach is source-proven not to reach provider replay.

options.title: Sponsor a rebased context fix
options.body: Rework this or a replacement branch so delivered commitment questions enter a replay-visible/pending-question path and prove the next Telegram reply has that context.

options.title: Narrow to prompt hardening
options.body: Keep only the no-visible-reasoning commitment prompt guard and leave reply-linkage/session-state behavior to the broader overlapping work.

options.title: Pause behind overlapping work
options.body: Leave this PR parked until a maintainer chooses whether https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/81382, https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/86491, or a new branch is the canonical fix.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a rebased context fix
recommendation.body: Rework this or a replacement branch so delivered commitment questions enter a replay-visible/pending-question path and prove the next Telegram reply has that context.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent heartbeat and transcript/replay history makes this the best available routing owner for the branch-direction choice.
